about: How the GridIronVault voice says what coaches write. One list for the Film Room's read-aloud (src/lib/readAloud.ts) and every social voiceover, so a word is fixed once, everywhere. Each rule is a regular expression (always global, plus any flags) and what to say instead; $1 and $2 are the parts in brackets. Rules run in order.

rules.why: 5v5 was read as five vee five
a 4-3 front was read as four dash three
2x2 was read as two ex two
Deep 1/3 was read as one slash three
the A gap was read as uh gap
the Will linebacker was read like the word will
curl/flat was read as curl slash flat
